item.title: Trump’s Korean gambit exposes a shifting East Asian order
item.description: Growing doubts about the US security umbrella are forcing new strategic calculations across the region.

item.title: Brighton & Hove Albion sign Algerian left-back Jaouen Hadjam
item.description: The 23-year-old joins from Swiss champions Young Boys on a five-year deal, making him the third Algerian in the league.

item.title: US Army Black Hawk helicopter crashes in Colorado
item.description: A US Army Black Hawk helicopter crashed after an unplanned landing in Colorado.

item.title: UN rejects Israel’s threat to expel Gaza residents over kite-flying
item.description: UN rights office spokesperson slams Israeli threat of forced evacuations from Gaza communities over kite flying.

item.title: Palestinian boy shot during Israeli raid on UNRWA centre
item.description: Video shows the moment a Palestinian boy was shot during an Israeli raid on a UN facility in occupied East Jerusalem.

item.title: The RSF’s defeat will not end Sudan’s war but merely fragment it
item.description: Sudanese army's battlefield gains rely on an armed coalition it may struggle to control once the common enemy is gone.

item.title: Man United’s Fernandes, City’s Shaw named PFA Players of the Year
item.description: Fernandes rewarded for an outstanding season with a record number of assists in the league; Shaw builds on league win and Golden Boot.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran’s partners: How do secondary sanctions work?
item.description: The US has used threats of secondary sanctions, whereby countries trading with a sanctioned country also face sanctions.

item.title: Serena Williams, Carlos Alcaraz fall in US Open mixed doubles quarterfinal
item.description: Star pair lost to Cobolli and Bencic, who will play married partners Elina Svitolina and Gael Monfils in the semifinal.

item.title: Iran, Oman agree on new temporary route in Hormuz
item.description: Deputy foreign minster says the route's entry as well as part of the exit would run through Iranian territorial waters.

item.title: Iran bets economic pain will pressure Trump in game of ‘chicken’
item.description: Iran is betting global economic fallout and Republicans worried about the midterms will force Trump's retreat.

item.title: Fireworks factory goes up in smoke in Mexico
item.description: Two explosions have hit a fireworks facility in Tultepec, Mexico, sending a spectacular mix of flames and explosions

item.title: Massive natural gas leak in Wisconsin puts community on alert
item.description: A truck hit a natural gas pipeline near Saxon, Wisconsin prompted nearby residents to evacuate.

item.title: Russia’s ‘Amazon’ Wildberries comes under Ukraine attack again
item.description: Russia’s biggest online retailer, Wildberries, has once again been attacked in a drone strike by Ukraine.

item.title: At least 14 babies killed in Pakistan hospital nursery fire
item.description: Only one infant rescued from the neonatal facility where the fire broke out, in Pakistan's capital.

item.title: Dozens killed in rebel attacks on Sudan’s Kordofan, medical group says
item.description: Sudan Doctors Network says SPLM-N rebels killed 27 people in South Kordofan, including four children.

item.title: Instagram chief testifies at Meta trial, says few teens used safety feature
item.description: Meta is on trial over claims it hooked young users on its platforms despite mental health risks.

item.title: Who were the Syrian Democratic Forces and why dissolve?
item.description: Syria’s Democratic Forces, which led the fight against ISIL, have declared they are disbanding.

item.title: Israeli soldiers block Knesset member from besieged Palestinian home
item.description: Israeli soldiers blocked Knesset member Ofer Cassif from reaching a Palestinian family home in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Mamdani opposes Hindu nationalist event in New York
item.description: Zohran Mamdani says he opposes a right-wing Hindu nationalist event scheduled for next week at Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Water crisis makes life in Sudan’s El Obeid refugee camps even worse
item.description: Families displaced by war in Sudan’s El Obeid refugee camps face crippling water shortages.

item.title: Malaysia’s Anwar puts non-aligned stance in focus with remarks on Taiwan
item.description: Malaysian leader's comments on the island have prompted discussion about whether the country is leaning towards China.

item.title: Is Sudan’s battlefield shaping the terms of its next political phase?
item.description: Army gains, RSF defections and al-Burhan’s political push point to a possible shift in Sudan’s war.

item.title: Human rights situation in Myanmar ‘plummets to new low’, UN says
item.description: New report says abuses against Rohingya and unchecked resource exploitation deepening crisis in Myanmar.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran says Hormuz remains closed despite Oman route deal
item.description: Tehran says the agreement with Oman on routes through Hormuz does not indicate that the strait is open.
